captions.detailed: A 3D model of a Swedish Regimental three-pounder field gun featuring a slim, dark-grey cast-iron barrel resting on a wooden trail carriage. The carriage is composed of brown wooden cheeks, a central trail body extending to the rear, and a solid black axle. Two large spoked wooden wheels with thin black outer rims are mounted on either side, allowing rotational movement around the axle while the barrel is pivoted on side trunnions for pitch adjustment.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a historic Swedish Regimental three-pounder field gun with a dark-grey cast-iron barrel, a brown wooden trail carriage, and two large multi-spoked wooden wheels on a central axle, ensuring the barrel and wheels are articulated with revolute joints.
captions.factory: The model is constructed by defining a carriage assembly using box shapes for the cheeks and trail, combined with a cylindrical axle. The barrel is modeled as a series of concentric cylinders and a sphere for the cascabel, connected to the carriage via a revolute trunnion joint. Each wheel is built by combining a central hub cylinder, a thin outer rim, and multiple rectangular spokes rotated radially, which are then attached to the axle using continuous revolute joints.
